What to look for: `_pad` is declared as `uint _pad[1]` (one element), but the shader
indexes it with the compile-time literal `2000`. Every pane below compiles this to
completion with an out-of-bounds index baked directly into the generated code (see the
final index operand of the `OpAccessChain` / `OpInBoundsAccessChain` in each SPIR-V dump)
and prints no warning or error about it. The DXC panes print nothing at all; the Clang
pane's only diagnostic is an unrelated "argument unused" note about an unused compiler
flag. Nothing here reports that `_pad`'s bound was violated by a constant that could have
been checked at compile time.
